name: hot_consensus_v1
registered: 2026-11-05, before computing it (follow-up to consensus_v1 at Tyler's request: 'what about unanimous hot pickers?')
hot: exactly the frozen hot-picker rule v1 (picks_hot_rules.json): a NAMED picker with >= 60% on >= 8 graded picks in the same sport over the 4 previous weeks is hot for the next week
unit_and_grading: same as consensus_v1: one row per (sport, game, class side|total), direction graded at the close, pushes dropped, break-even 52.38%

groups.H2: >= 2 hot pickers on one direction and 0 hot pickers on the other (primary)
groups.H2_all: H2 and nobody (hot or not) on the other direction
groups.H1: exactly 1 hot picker on the direction, 0 hot against (comparison)

test: primary H2: one-sided binomial p < 0.05 for cover > 52.38%; the other groups are descriptive. A pass is a lead to freeze and judge on games after 2026-11-05, not an edge
